newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end bit weaker on corrective sales.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end bit weaker on corrective sales.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed slightly lower on Thursday due to profit-taking after the previous day's sharp advance in the key average by more than three percent.

Brokers said investors were prompted to secure temporary profits as the dollar briefly dipped below 116.00 yen. The yen's strength against the dollar fuels worries that it may hurt Japanese exporters' profits.
The 225-share Nikkei average lost 39.11 points or 0.19 percent to finish at 20,312.23. June Nikkei futures fell 90 points to 20,310.
